recipe.visualDefinition: A high-impact urban music graphic featuring massive, gold-textured 3D block lettering centered on a dark red, diagonally-hatched background with spray-paint splatter and drip effects.
coreVisualRelationships: Gold 3D text against a deep crimson textured background
Aggressive upward-angled perspective on central typography
Rough, gritty textures contrasting with polished metallic highlights
Vertical paint drips breaking the horizontal flow of the text
coreInvariants: Deep red background with diagonal scan-line or hatch texture
3D extrusion depth pointing downward and outward
Gold/yellow color palette for primary typography
Splatter and drip accents on the left side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary text block is centrally located, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space with a wide horizontal span.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central 3D acronym with its bright yellow-to-gold gradient.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top artist name, drop to the massive central text, follow the downward 3D extrusion, and land on the spaced-out subtitle below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Darker vignetted corners and the upper/lower thirds provide breathing room for the dense central graphic.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Yellow/Gold (Primary text faces and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, high-saturation yellow text pops against a low-value, medium-saturation red background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, gold, black, and white

letterConstructionRules: Extreme 3D extrusion with a downward perspective
Horizontal inner-line texture on the face of the letters
Slightly irregular, distressed edges to simulate street-art stencils
characterSpecificRedesigns: Hashtag symbol integrated with long vertical paint drips
Letters in the main title are tightly kerned to overlap slightly
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display face paired with a clean, widely-spaced minimalist sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the 3D extrusion effect.
Works well for the widely-spaced subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark crimson background with a heavy diagonal hatch texture and a dark vignette. Add subtle wood-grain-like textures and spray paint splatters in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary text in a heavy 3D block style with a gold gradient and horizontal line texture on the face. Add long white and yellow paint drips falling from the left side of the text.

verificationChecks: Is the 3D depth consistent across all letters?
Does the hashtag feature the vertical drip effect?
Is the background texture visible through the darker areas?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the diagonal hatch texture
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or trademarked logos
Ensure the hashtag is a generic graphic element
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic metallic sheen on the gold text
Ensure the 3D perspective doesn't distort letter legibility
Verify the background texture doesn't overwhelm the subtitle
Confirm the paint drips look organic and not perfectly straight
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Heavy 3D Gold Typography] with [Diagonal Hatched Crimson Background] and [Urban Spray Paint Accents] for a high-energy music aesthetic.
